<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8" />
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
<title>Nallam Eswara Sai Akhil — QA Engineer</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Space+Grotesk:wght@400;500;600;700&family=IBM+Plex+Sans:wght@400;500;600&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root{
    --bg:#0E1620;
    --panel:#131F2B;
    --panel-2:#0F1B26;
    --border:#233648;
    --border-soft:#1B2A38;
    --text:#E7ECF2;
    --muted:#8CA0B3;
    --muted-2:#5E7488;
    --pass:#34C77B;
    --pass-dim:#1E4A38;
    --gold:#E7A93C;
    --gold-dim:#4A3B1E;
    --mono:'IBM Plex Mono', monospace;
    --sans:'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif;
    --display:'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
    --hero-bg-image: url('data:image/jpeg;base64,');
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box; margin:0; padding:0;}
  html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}
  body{
    background:
      radial-gradient(ellipse 900px 500px at 85% -5%, rgba(52,199,123,0.10), transparent 60%),
      radial-gradient(ellipse 700px 500px at -10% 15%, rgba(231,169,60,0.06), transparent 60%),
      var(--bg);
    color:var(--text);
    font-family:var(--sans);
    line-height:1.6;
    -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
    background-attachment:fixed;
  }
  .grain{
    position:fixed; inset:0; pointer-events:none; z-index:0; opacity:0.5;
    background-image:radial-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,0.035) 1px, transparent 1px);
    background-size:26px 26px;
    mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 100% 60% at 50% 0%, black 0%, transparent 75%);
  }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){
    html{scroll-behavior:auto;}
    *{animation-duration:0.001ms !important; transition-duration:0.001ms !important;}
  }
  a{color:inherit;}
  ::selection{background:var(--pass-dim); color:var(--text);}

  .wrap{max-width:900px; margin:0 auto; padding:0 28px; position:relative; z-index:1;}

  /* ---------- NAV ---------- */
  header.nav{
    position:sticky; top:0; z-index:50;
    background:rgba(14,22,32,0.88);
    backdrop-filter:blur(10px);
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-soft);
  }
  .nav-inner{
    max-width:840px; margin:0 auto; padding:0 28px;
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between;
    height:56px;
  }
  .nav-id{font-family:var(--mono); font-size:13px; color:var(--muted); letter-spacing:0.02em;}
  .nav-id b{color:var(--text); font-weight:500;}
  .nav-links{display:flex; gap:22px; list-style:none;}
  .nav-links a{
    font-family:var(--mono); font-size:12.5px; color:var(--muted);
    text-decoration:none; padding:4px 2px; border-bottom:2px solid transparent;
    transition:color .15s ease, border-color .15s ease;
  }
  .nav-links a:hover{color:var(--text);}
  .nav-links a.active{color:var(--pass); border-color:var(--pass);}
  .nav-cta{
    font-family:var(--mono); font-size:12px; color:var(--bg);
    background:var(--pass); padding:7px 12px; border-radius:3px;
    text-decoration:none; font-weight:600; white-space:nowrap;
  }
  @media (max-width:640px){
    .nav-links{display:none;}
  }

  /* ---------- HERO ---------- */
  .hero{
    padding:64px 28px 40px; margin:0 -28px; position:relative; overflow:hidden;
    border-radius:0 0 14px 14px;
  }
  .hero::before{
    content:''; position:absolute; inset:0; z-index:0;
    background-image:
      linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(14,22,32,0.82) 0%, rgba(14,22,32,0.78) 55%, var(--bg) 100%),
      var(--hero-bg-image);
    background-size:cover; background-position:center 30%;
  }
  .hero > *{position:relative; z-index:1;}
  .hero-eyebrow{
    font-family:var(--mono); font-size:12.5px; color:var(--pass);
    display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; margin-bottom:18px;
  }
  .dot{width:7px; height:7px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--pass); box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--pass-dim);}
  h1{
    font-family:var(--display); font-weight:600;
    font-size:clamp(32px, 5.2vw, 48px);
    line-height:1.08; letter-spacing:-0.01em;
    max-width:11ch;
  }
  .role-line{
    font-family:var(--sans); font-size:18px; color:var(--muted);
    margin-top:14px; max-width:52ch;
  }
  .hero-summary{
    margin-top:18px; color:var(--muted); max-width:60ch; font-size:15.5px;
  }

  .stat-strip{
    margin-top:32px; display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);
    border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:6px; overflow:hidden;
  }
  .stat{
    padding:16px 14px; border-right:1px solid var(--border);
    background:var(--panel);
  }
  .stat:last-child{border-right:none;}
  .stat-num{font-family:var(--mono); font-size:22px; font-weight:600; color:var(--text);}
  .stat-label{font-family:var(--mono); font-size:11px; color:var(--muted-2); margin-top:4px; letter-spacing:0.01em;}
  @media (max-width:640px){
    .stat-strip{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);}
    .stat:nth-child(2){border-right:none;}
    .stat:nth-child(4){border-right:none;}
  }

  .hero-actions{margin-top:28px; display:flex; gap:12px; flex-wrap:wrap;}

  .hero-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 220px; gap:36px; align-items:start;}
  @media (max-width:700px){
    .hero-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr; }
    .hero-photo-wrap{order:-1; width:150px; margin:0 auto 8px;}
  }
  .hero-photo-wrap{position:relative; width:220px;}
  .hero-photo-glow{
    position:absolute; inset:-18px; z-index:0;
    background:radial-gradient(circle, rgba(52,199,123,0.22), transparent 70%);
    filter:blur(6px);
  }
  .hero-photo{
    position:relative; z-index:1; width:100%; aspect-ratio:3/4; object-fit:cover;
    border-radius:10px; border:1px solid var(--border);
    box-shadow:0 20px 40px -14px rgba(0,0,0,0.55);
  }
  .hero-photo-tag{
    position:absolute; z-index:2; bottom:-12px; left:50%; transform:translateX(-50%);
    background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--pass-dim); color:var(--pass);
    font-family:var(--mono); font-size:10.5px; padding:5px 10px; border-radius:20px;
    white-space:nowrap; box-shadow:0 6px 16px -6px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
  }
  .hero-photo-tag .dot2{width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--pass); display:inline-block; margin-right:5px;}
  .btn{
    font-family:var(--mono); font-size:13px; padding:10px 16px; border-radius:4px;
    text-decoration:none; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;
    border:1px solid var(--border); transition:border-color .15s ease, background .15s ease;
  }
  .btn-primary{background:var(--pass); color:var(--bg); border-color:var(--pass); font-weight:600;}
  .btn-primary:hover{background:#2bb56b;}
  .btn-ghost{color:var(--text);}
  .btn-ghost:hover{border-color:var(--muted);}

  /* ---------- SECTION SHELL ---------- */
  section{padding:56px 0; border-top:1px solid var(--border-soft);}
  .sec-head{display:flex; align-items:baseline; gap:12px; margin-bottom:28px;}
  .sec-tag{font-family:var(--mono); font-size:12px; color:var(--muted-2);}
  .sec-title{font-family:var(--display); font-size:23px; font-weight:600;}

  /* ---------- EXPERIENCE (log style) ---------- */
  .log{position:relative; padding-left:26px;}
  .log::before{
    content:''; position:absolute; left:6px; top:6px; bottom:6px; width:1px;
    background:var(--border);
  }
  .entry{position:relative; margin-bottom:36px;}
  .entry:last-child{margin-bottom:0;}
  .entry::before{
    content:''; position:absolute; left:-26px; top:6px; width:9px; height:9px;
    border-radius:50%; background:var(--pass); box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--pass-dim);
  }
  .entry.investigator::before{background:var(--gold); box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--gold-dim);}
  .entry-head{
    display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:baseline; gap:12px; flex-wrap:wrap;
    cursor:pointer;
  }
  .entry-title{font-family:var(--display); font-weight:600; font-size:17px;}
  .entry-org{color:var(--muted); font-size:14.5px; margin-top:2px;}
  .entry-date{font-family:var(--mono); font-size:12px; color:var(--muted-2); white-space:nowrap;}
  .entry-toggle{
    font-family:var(--mono); font-size:11px; color:var(--muted-2);
    display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; margin-top:10px; user-select:none;
  }
  .entry-toggle .chevron{transition:transform .2s ease; display:inline-block;}
  .entry.open .entry-toggle .chevron{transform:rotate(90deg);}
  .entry-body{
    max-height:0; overflow:hidden; transition:max-height .3s ease;
  }
  .entry.open .entry-body{max-height:600px;}
  .entry-list{list-style:none; margin-top:14px; padding-top:2px;}
  .entry-list li{
    position:relative; padding-left:20px; margin-bottom:10px; font-size:14.5px; color:#C5D1DC;
  }
  .entry-list li::before{
    content:'✓'; position:absolute; left:0; top:0; color:var(--pass); font-family:var(--mono); font-size:13px;
  }

  /* ---------- SKILLS ---------- */
  .skill-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:14px;}
  @media (max-width:640px){.skill-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}
  .skill-group{
    border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:6px; padding:16px 18px; background:var(--panel);
  }
  .skill-group-title{
    font-family:var(--mono); font-size:11.5px; color:var(--gold);
    letter-spacing:0.02em; margin-bottom:10px;
  }
  .chips{display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:7px;}
  .chip{
    font-family:var(--mono); font-size:12px; color:var(--text);
    border:1px solid var(--border-soft); background:var(--panel-2);
    padding:5px 9px; border-radius:3px;
  }

  /* ---------- AWARDS / CERTIFICATE CARDS ---------- */
  .award-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3, 1fr); gap:14px;}
  @media (max-width:820px){ .award-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2, 1fr);} }
  @media (max-width:520px){ .award-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;} }
  .award-card{
    border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:8px; overflow:hidden; background:var(--panel);
    cursor:pointer; transition:border-color .15s ease, transform .15s ease;
    display:flex; flex-direction:column;
  }
  .award-card:hover{border-color:var(--pass); transform:translateY(-2px);}
  .award-thumb{
    width:100%; aspect-ratio:4/3; object-fit:cover; display:block;
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-soft); background:#08111a;
  }
  .award-card-body{padding:12px 14px 14px; flex:1; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:6px;}
  .award-status{
    font-family:var(--mono); font-size:9.5px; letter-spacing:0.03em;
    display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:5px; width:fit-content;
    padding:3px 7px; border-radius:20px;
  }
  .award-status.won{color:var(--pass); background:var(--pass-dim); border:1px solid #2a6b4c;}
  .award-status.nom{color:var(--gold); background:var(--gold-dim); border:1px solid #6b551f;}
  .award-name{font-family:var(--display); font-weight:600; font-size:14.5px; line-height:1.3;}
  .award-meta{font-family:var(--mono); font-size:11px; color:var(--muted-2);}
  .award-quote{font-size:12.5px; color:var(--muted); font-style:italic; margin-top:2px;}

  /* ---------- LIGHTBOX ---------- */
  .lightbox{
    position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:100; background:rgba(6,10,15,0.86);
    backdrop-filter:blur(4px);
    display:none; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:28px;
  }
  .lightbox.open{display:flex;}
  .lightbox-inner{max-width:720px; width:100%;}
  .lightbox-inner img{width:100%; border-radius:8px; border:1px solid var(--border); display:block;}
  .lightbox-cap{
    display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:baseline; gap:10px;
    margin-top:12px; flex-wrap:wrap;
  }
  .lightbox-title{font-family:var(--display); font-weight:600; font-size:16px;}
  .lightbox-meta{font-family:var(--mono); font-size:11.5px; color:var(--muted);}
  .lightbox-close{
    position:absolute; top:22px; right:28px; font-family:var(--mono); font-size:13px;
    color:var(--text); background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--border);
    padding:7px 12px; border-radius:4px; cursor:pointer;
  }
  .lightbox-close:hover{border-color:var(--pass); color:var(--pass);}

  /* ---------- EDUCATION ---------- */
  .edu-row{display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:baseline; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:8px;}
  .edu-degree{font-family:var(--display); font-weight:600; font-size:17px;}
  .edu-school{color:var(--muted); margin-top:4px; font-size:14.5px;}
  .edu-date{font-family:var(--mono); font-size:12px; color:var(--muted-2);}
  .edu-note{font-family:var(--mono); font-size:12px; color:var(--pass); margin-top:10px;}

  /* ---------- CONTACT ---------- */
  .contact-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:14px;}
  @media (max-width:640px){.contact-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}
  .contact-card{
    border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:6px; padding:16px 18px; background:var(--panel);
    display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; gap:10px;
  }
  .contact-label{font-family:var(--mono); font-size:11px; color:var(--muted-2);}
  .contact-value{font-size:14.5px; margin-top:4px; word-break:break-all;}
  .copy-btn{
    font-family:var(--mono); font-size:11px; color:var(--muted); background:transparent;
    border:1px solid var(--border-soft); padding:6px 9px; border-radius:3px; cursor:pointer;
    flex-shrink:0;
  }
  .copy-btn:hover{border-color:var(--pass); color:var(--pass);}
  .copy-btn.copied{color:var(--pass); border-color:var(--pass);}

  footer{
    padding:30px 0 50px; text-align:center;
    font-family:var(--mono); font-size:11.5px; color:var(--muted-2);
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="grain"></div>

<header class="nav">
  <div class="nav-inner">
    <div class="nav-id"><b>N. Eswara Sai Akhil</b> · qa-profile.log</div>
    <ul class="nav-links" id="navLinks">
      <li><a href="#experience" data-sec="experience">experience</a></li>
      <li><a href="#skills" data-sec="skills">tools</a></li>
      <li><a href="#awards" data-sec="awards">awards</a></li>
      <li><a href="#education" data-sec="education">education</a></li>
      <li><a href="#contact" data-sec="contact">contact</a></li>
    </ul>
    <a class="nav-cta" href="mailto:saiakhilnallam@gmail.com">Hire me</a>
  </div>
</header>

<main class="wrap">

  <section class="hero" style="border-top:none;">
    <div class="hero-grid">
      <div>
        <div class="hero-eyebrow"><span class="dot"></span> AVAILABLE — OPEN TO MANUAL &amp; FUNCTIONAL QA ROLES · HYDERABAD</div>
        <h1>Nallam Eswara Sai Akhil</h1>
        <div class="role-line">ISTQB Certified QA Engineer — Manual &amp; Functional Testing across mobile, web and enterprise applications.</div>
        <p class="hero-summary">
          2.5+ years testing a live mobile e-commerce app end-to-end: functional, regression and defect
          lifecycle work in an Agile team, with growing exposure to API validation, SQL, and test automation.
        </p>
      </div>
      <div class="hero-photo-wrap">
        <div class="hero-photo-glow"></div>
        <img class="hero-photo" src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Nallam Eswara Sai Akhil" />
        <div class="hero-photo-tag"><span class="dot2"></span>ISTQB Certified</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="stat-strip">
      <div class="stat"><div class="stat-num">2.5</div><div class="stat-label">YEARS EXP.</div></div>
      <div class="stat"><div class="stat-num">7,000+</div><div class="stat-label">TEST CASES WRITTEN</div></div>
      <div class="stat"><div class="stat-num">1000+</div><div class="stat-label">DEFECTS LOGGED</div></div>
      <div class="stat"><div class="stat-num">ISTQB</div><div class="stat-label">CERTIFIED</div></div>
      <div class="stat"><div class="stat-num">7</div><div class="stat-label">AWARDS &amp; NOMINATIONS</div></div>
    </div>

    <div class="hero-actions">
      <a class="btn btn-primary" href="data:application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document;base64," download="Akhil_Resume_ManualQA.docx">↓ Download résumé</a>
      <a class="btn btn-ghost" href="mailto:saiakhilnallam@gmail.com">Email me</a>
      <a class="btn btn-ghost" href="tel:+919618473181">Call</a>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section id="experience">
    <div class="sec-head">
      <span class="sec-tag">01</span>
      <span class="sec-title">Experience</span>
    </div>

    <div class="log">
      <div class="entry open">
        <div class="entry-head" onclick="toggleEntry(this)">
          <div>
            <div class="entry-title">Quality Assurance Engineer</div>
            <div class="entry-org">Tata Consultancy Services India — Boots UK Limited account · Bhubaneswar, Odisha</div>
          </div>
          <div class="entry-date">Mar 2024 — Present</div>
        </div>
        <div class="entry-toggle"><span class="chevron">▸</span> test log</div>
        <div class="entry-body">
          <ul class="entry-list">
            <li>Perform manual and functional testing of a mobile e-commerce app across Android &amp; iOS — functional, regression, smoke and sanity coverage every release.</li>
            <li>Design and execute test cases and test cycles in Zephyr — 7,000+ test cases written and 1000+ defects identified to date.</li>
            <li>Validate API requests, responses and network traffic with Charles Proxy to debug API-level failures.</li>
            <li>Test app integrations with Salesforce Commerce Cloud (product data) and Salesforce Marketing Cloud (customer journeys, push &amp; in-app messaging).</li>
            <li>Validate dynamic content via Amplience CMS and track user journeys through Adobe Experience Cloud.</li>
            <li>Log, document and track defects in Jira with clear repro steps; retest fixes with developers.</li>
            <li>Collaborate cross-functionally with developers, product owners and stakeholders in an Agile/Scrum team.</li>
          </ul>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="entry investigator">
        <div class="entry-head" onclick="toggleEntry(this)">
          <div>
            <div class="entry-title">Transaction Risk Investigator</div>
            <div class="entry-org">Amazon Pvt India — Remote · Hyderabad</div>
          </div>
          <div class="entry-date">Jan 2024 — Mar 2024</div>
        </div>
        <div class="entry-toggle"><span class="chevron">▸</span> test log</div>
        <div class="entry-body">
          <ul class="entry-list">
            <li>Investigated unusual buyer/seller/vendor activity patterns using the Paragon tool, deciding independently with high accuracy.</li>
            <li>Identified &amp; reported 30+ policy-violating sellers in 45 days — a structured, detail-first workflow that carries directly into defect triage.</li>
          </ul>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section id="skills">
    <div class="sec-head">
      <span class="sec-tag">02</span>
      <span class="sec-title">Tools &amp; Methods</span>
    </div>
    <div class="skill-grid">
      <div class="skill-group">
        <div class="skill-group-title">TESTING TYPES</div>
        <div class="chips">
          <span class="chip">Functional</span><span class="chip">Regression</span>
          <span class="chip">Smoke</span><span class="chip">Sanity</span>
          <span class="chip">Integration</span><span class="chip">UI</span>
          <span class="chip">Cross-browser</span><span class="chip">End-to-end</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="skill-group">
        <div class="skill-group-title">DEFECT &amp; TEST MGMT</div>
        <div class="chips">
          <span class="chip">Jira</span><span class="chip">Confluence</span>
          <span class="chip">Zephyr</span><span class="chip">SDLC / STLC</span>
          <span class="chip">Agile / Scrum</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="skill-group">
        <div class="skill-group-title">API &amp; DATA</div>
        <div class="chips">
          <span class="chip">Charles Proxy</span><span class="chip">API validation</span>
          <span class="chip">Basic SQL</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="skill-group">
        <div class="skill-group-title">ENTERPRISE PLATFORMS</div>
        <div class="chips">
          <span class="chip">Salesforce Commerce Cloud</span><span class="chip">Salesforce Marketing Cloud</span>
          <span class="chip">Amplience CMS</span><span class="chip">Adobe Experience Cloud</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="skill-group" style="grid-column:1/-1;">
        <div class="skill-group-title">BUILDING TOWARD (AUTOMATION)</div>
        <div class="chips">
          <span class="chip">Java</span><span class="chip">Selenium</span>
          <span class="chip">Appium</span><span class="chip">Cucumber</span>
          <span class="chip">IntelliJ</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section id="awards">
    <div class="sec-head">
      <span class="sec-tag">03</span>
      <span class="sec-title">Awards &amp; Recognition</span>
    </div>
    <p style="color:var(--muted); font-size:13.5px; margin-top:-16px; margin-bottom:22px;">
      7 recognitions across two organisations — click any card to view the original certificate.
    </p>
    <div class="award-grid" id="awardGrid">
      <div class="award-card" onclick="openLightbox('on_the_spot')">
        <img class="award-thumb" src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="On the Spot Team Award certificate">
        <div class="award-card-body">
          <span class="award-status won">✓ WINNER</span>
          <div class="award-name">On the Spot (Team) Award</div>
          <div class="award-meta">TCS Gems · 07 Aug 2026</div>

<div class="lightbox" id="lightbox" onclick="if(event.target===this)closeLightbox()">
  <button class="lightbox-close" onclick="closeLightbox()">✕ close</button>
  <div class="lightbox-inner">
    <img id="lightboxImg" src="" alt="Certificate">
    <div class="lightbox-cap">
      <div class="lightbox-title" id="lightboxTitle"></div>
      <div class="lightbox-meta" id="lightboxMeta"></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<footer>Built from a résumé that's still being written — feel free to reach out. Last updated Sep 2026.</footer>

<script>
  const CERTS = {
    best_team:        {src:'data:image/jpeg;base64,',        title:'Best Team Award',              meta:'TCS Gems · 11 Dec 2025'},
    empowerment_win:  {src:'data:image/jpeg;base64,',  title:'The Empowerment Award',         meta:'Boots · Golden Boots Awards'},
    entertainer_win:  {src:'data:image/jpeg;base64,',  title:'The Entertainer Award — PI 29', meta:'Boots · 28 Nov 2025'},
    applause:         {src:'data:image/jpeg;base64,',         title:'Applause for Team Award',       meta:'TCS Gems · 08 Jun 2026'},
    on_the_spot:      {src:'data:image/jpeg;base64,',      title:'On the Spot (Team) Award',      meta:'TCS Gems · 07 Aug 2026'},
    icebreaker:       {src:'data:image/jpeg;base64,',       title:'The Icebreaker Award',          meta:'Boots · Team Mobile Apps · PI 30 · 24 Feb 2026'},
    usain_bolt:       {src:'data:image/jpeg;base64,',        title:'The Usain Bolt Award',          meta:'Boots · Nominated · 28 May 2025'},
  };
  function openLightbox(key){
    const c = CERTS[key];
    document.getElementById('lightboxImg').src = c.src;
    document.getElementById('lightboxTitle').textContent = c.title;
    document.getElementById('lightboxMeta').textContent = c.meta;
    document.getElementById('lightbox').classList.add('open');
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
  }
  function closeLightbox(){
    document.getElementById('lightbox').classList.remove('open');
    document.body.style.overflow = '';
  }
  document.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if(e.key === 'Escape') closeLightbox(); });

  function toggleEntry(headEl){
    const entry = headEl.closest('.entry');
    entry.classList.toggle('open');
  }

  function copyText(btn, text){
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(()=>{
      const original = btn.textContent;
      btn.textContent = 'copied';
      btn.classList.add('copied');
      setTimeout(()=>{ btn.textContent = original; btn.classList.remove('copied'); }, 1600);
    });
  }

  // scrollspy
  const links = document.querySelectorAll('.nav-links a');
  const sections = Array.from(links).map(l => document.getElementById(l.dataset.sec));
  function onScroll(){
    let current = sections[0];
    const y = window.scrollY + 90;
    sections.forEach(sec => { if(sec && sec.offsetTop <= y) current = sec; });
    links.forEach(l => l.classList.toggle('active', current && l.dataset.sec === current.id));
  }
  window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, {passive:true});
  onScroll();
</script>

</body>
